Omid Amini, Matthew Baker, Erwan Brugallé and Joseph Rabinoff, Lifting harmonic morphisms I: metrized complexes and Berkovich skeleta, Research in the Mathematical Sciences 2, article 7 (2015), Example 8.6; arXiv:1303.4812v3, 15 April 2014. Full negative answer to the universal surjectivity question attributed to Ribet in Rabinoff's OWR contribution: a finite degree-two map X′→X over C((t)), with X a genus-two Mumford curve and the minimal regular source special fiber two copies of P¹ meeting transversely in four nodes, induces Z/4→Z/8, j↦2j, with cokernel Z/2. Fixed-ground-field tame lifting and component-map naturality are explicit imported inputs. The construction is already stated in OWR 53/2012, pp.3247–3248, and proved in the cited prior article; this is an existing published result, with no new project theorem or upload. The inspected arXiv v3 p.50 and publisher PDF p.65 reverse the source/target group-order labels; independent calculation corrects them to source4,target8 and preserves the negative conclusion. This is a local verified correction, not an author-approved corrigendum or a claim about uninspected versions. The original OWR target graph also has a local repeated-prime label.
